senses.gloss:
(इ) क्लिदि r. 1st cl. (क्लिंदते-ति)
To bewail, to lament, to weep.
(ऊ, इर); इर क्लिदू r. 4th cl. (क्लिद्युति)
To be or become wet, damp, &c.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Wet, moistened.
E.
क्लिद to be or become wet, irr. participle.

m. (-त्मा)
Excess of the lachrymal discharge, watering of the eyes.
E.
क्लिन्न, and वर्त्मन् the eyelid.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Blear-eyed.
E.
क्लिन्न wet, and अक्ष the eye.

(उ) क्लिशु r. 4th cl. (क्लिश्यते)
1 To suffer distress.
2 To inflict or cause distress;
(ऊ,) क्लिशू r. 9th cl. (क्लिश्नाति)
1 To oppose.
2 To afflict, to distress.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Distrest, afflicted, wearied.
E.
क्लिश to be distrest, &c. affix क्त with इद inserted; also without इट् क्लिष्ट^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301. note: missing space.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Suffering pain or distress.
E.
क्लिश, and क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Distrest, afflicted, &c.
2 Inconsistent, contradictory.
E.
क्लिश to be distrest, &c. affix क्त, deriv. irr.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Calamity, distress.
2 Service.
E.
क्लिश to afflict, क्तिन् aff.

n. (-कं)
Liquorice, (Glycirrhiza glabra?)
E.
क्लीव to be weak, affix क्त, व being dropped; क्लीत weakness, कल to remove, and ल dropped by affixing ड.

f. (-का)
The indigo plant, (Indigofera Indica.)
E.
क्रीतक traffic, कन् pleonastic, the fem. form; र is changed to ल.

(ऋ) क्लीबृ r. 1st cl. (क्लीबते)
1 To be impotent.
2 To be timorous, to be modest or unassuming.

(ऋ) क्लीबृ r. 1st cl. (क्लीवते)
1 To be impotent.
2 To be timid or modest.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Weak, impotent.
2 Idle, slothful.
mn. (-वः-वं)
1 The neuter gender.
2 A eunuch.
E.
क्लीव to be weak or timid, affix क; also read क्लीव.
